title: validateApp requires team; pass team from package.json in 3 apps; bump shared-contracts to 2.0.0

summary: validateApp in libs/shared-contracts now throws if app.team is missing; core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass the team matching their package.json. shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0 (breaking). Assumptions: lib lives in mono and is inlined, so platform-kit needs no change; team values hardcoded as literals (build has no JSON import) matching package.json; README fake-bucket-name cleanup was called a separate thing, so not done. PR #1 merged, CI+CD green.
